title: Chaos Structures
description: Every 60 seconds, a random player is chosen and a random vanilla structure spawns nearby. Players receive countdown warnings and a bossbar timer, turning every world into unpredictable chaos.
body:
### Random Structures

Random Structures adds unexpected events to your world by spawning random vanilla structures near players every 60 seconds.

A random online player is selected, and a random structure appears nearby. Players are warned before each spawn with countdown messages and a bossbar timer, making every world feel more dynamic and unpredictable.

Perfect for survival worlds, fun multiplayer experiences with friends, and chaos themed playthroughs.

### Features
- Automatic structure spawns every 60 seconds.
- Randomly selects an online player.
- Spawns vanilla structures near the selected player.
- Countdown warnings at 20, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 seconds.
- Bossbar timer showing the time until the next structure.
- Join messages explaining how the mod works.
- Broadcast announcements showing which player was selected and what structure spawned.
- Singleplayer and multiplayer supported

### Included Structures
- Plains Village
- Desert Village
- Savanna Village
- Taiga Village
- Snowy Village
- Desert Pyramid
- Jungle Temple
- Swamp Hut
- Igloo
- Shipwreck
